Three-panel academic concept figure for an EMNLP 2026 paper (full width, figsize 14x5.5 inches, 300 DPI):

Title: None (caption is separate in LaTeX). Panel labels "(a)", "(b)", "(c)" at top-left of each panel in 12pt bold serif (Times), color #1A2744 (dark navy).

OVERALL CONCEPT: Shows how the dominant predictor of panel vulnerability shifts from individual judge weakness (η_max) at small panels to structural diversity (K_eff) at larger panels. This is the paper's central finding: "predictor relevance transition."

=== LAYOUT ===
Three panels side by side, each ~31% width, separated by generous whitespace (wspace=0.08). Each panel has:
- Top region (~65%): conceptual diagram
- Bottom region (~35%): "Predictor Weight" stacked horizontal bars

=== COLOR SEMANTICS (CRITICAL) ===
- η_max (individual weakness): warm palette — fill #FDF0EF (light rose), accent #C0392B (deep red), bar #D4654A (warm coral)
- K_eff (diversity/correlation): cool palette — fill #EDF4FB (light blue), accent #2980B9 (blue), bar #2A6B5A (teal)
- Neutral/healthy judges: light gray #F5F6F7 fill, #DEE2E6 border
- Panel backgrounds: progressive tint from (a) warm #FDF0EF to (b) neutral #F8F4FB (lavender) to (c) cool #EDF4FB — conveying the shift from η_max to K_eff dominance
- Attack arrows: #C0392B (red), 1.5pt

=== PANEL (a): "K = 3: Weakest Link" ===
Background: rounded rectangle, fill #FDF0EF (warm rose), border #E8C4C0, 0.8pt, corner radius 12px.

TOP DIAGRAM:
- 3 circles (r=18px) arranged in a triangle formation representing 3 judges
  - Top-left circle: fill #F5F6F7, border #DEE2E6, 1pt — healthy judge, label "J₁" inside in 8pt
  - Top-right circle: fill #F5F6F7, border #DEE2E6, 1pt — healthy judge, label "J₂" inside in 8pt
  - Bottom-center circle: fill #FADBD8 (light red), border #C0392B, 2pt, LARGER (r=22px) — vulnerable judge, label "J₃" inside in 8pt bold red
- A thick red arrow (2pt, #C0392B) pointing at J₃ from below-left, with a small crosshair/target icon at the arrow base — representing the adversary targeting the weakest judge
- A small "majority vote" box below the triangle: rounded rect, 3 cells side by side — two green checkmarks (✓, #27AE60) and one red X (✗, #C0392B), with text "2/3 → safe" in 8pt below. Then show a SECOND row where the attack flips J₃: one green ✓, one red ✗, one red ✗ (from J₃), text "1/3 → FAIL" in 8pt bold red below
- Annotation text: "One flip ≈ majority shift" in 8pt italic #777777

BOTTOM BAR ("Predictor Weight"):
- Label "Predictor Weight" in 7pt bold #555555, left-aligned
- Two horizontal bars, stacked vertically:
  - "η_max" label (7pt, #C0392B): bar width ~75% of panel width, fill #D4654A, rounded ends
  - "K_eff" label (7pt, #2980B9): bar width ~35% of panel width, fill #2A6B5A, rounded ends
- Right-aligned values: "β = 0.243" and "β = 0.175" in 7pt mono

=== PANEL (b): "K = 5: Transition" ===
Background: rounded rectangle, fill #F8F4FB (light lavender), border #D5C8E0, 0.8pt, corner radius 12px.

TOP DIAGRAM:
- 5 circles (r=15px) arranged in a pentagon formation
  - 4 circles: fill #F5F6F7, border #DEE2E6, 1pt — healthy judges (J₁-J₄)
  - 1 circle (bottom): fill #FADBD8, border #C0392B, 1.5pt — vulnerable judge (J₅), slightly larger (r=17px)
- Thin dashed lines (#B0BEC5, 0.5pt) connecting SOME pairs of judges (showing pairwise correlations) — not all pairs, just ~4-5 connections to suggest MI structure
- A red arrow targeting J₅, but THINNER (1pt) and SHORTER than in panel (a) — the attack still targets the weak judge but its impact is diluted
- A faded version of the voting box: "2/5 flipped → still safe" in 8pt #777777
- Annotation: "Impact diluted" in 8pt italic #777777

BOTTOM BAR:
- "η_max": bar width ~45%, fill #D4654A with 60% opacity (fading)
- "K_eff": bar width ~50%, fill #2A6B5A
- Values: "β = 0.091" and "β = 0.286" in 7pt mono

=== PANEL (c): "K ≥ 5: Diversity Dominance" ===
Background: rounded rectangle, fill #EDF4FB (cool blue), border #B8D4E8, 0.8pt, corner radius 12px.

TOP DIAGRAM:
- 7 circles (r=13px) arranged in a heptagon/circular formation
  - 6 circles: fill #F5F6F7, border #DEE2E6, 1pt
  - 1 circle: fill #FADBD8, border #C0392B, 1pt (vulnerable, but NOT larger — its visual dominance is reduced)
- PROMINENT dashed/solid lines connecting many pairs of judges — a DENSE web of connections (#2980B9, 0.8pt, varying opacity 0.3-0.7) representing the pairwise MI structure. This web of connections is the visual focus, not any single judge.
- Small red arrow at the weak judge (0.7pt, faded #C0392B at 50% opacity) — de-emphasized
- Annotation: "Correlation structure dominates" in 8pt italic #2980B9
- A small callout near the connection web: "K_eff = 4.53 < K = 7" in 7pt bold #2A6B5A

BOTTOM BAR:
- "η_max": bar width ~25%, fill #D4654A with 40% opacity (very faded)
- "K_eff": bar width ~80%, fill #2A6B5A
- Values: "β = 0.086 (n.s.)" and "β = 0.353" in 7pt mono, where "n.s." is in #999999

=== CONNECTING ELEMENT ===
A thin horizontal arrow (1pt, #777777) spanning across all three panels at the very bottom, below the predictor bars. Label centered: "Panel size K →" in 8pt #555555. At left end: small text "η_max dominates" in 7pt #C0392B. At right end: "K_eff dominates" in 7pt #2A6B5A.

=== OVERALL STYLE ===
- 300 DPI, pure white background outside panels, publication quality for EMNLP 2026
- Elegant, premium, sophisticated — NOT cheap or homework-like
- Subtle drop shadows (2px offset, 8% opacity) on all panel backgrounds
- Rounded corners 12px on panel backgrounds, 8px on inner elements
- Serif font (Times) for panel labels and main text, sans-serif for annotations
- Thin elegant visual elements throughout — NOT thick matplotlib defaults
- NO matplotlib default styling: NO gray background, NO gridlines, NO tab10 colors
- All judge circles should look like clean, professional icons
- The connection lines in panel (c) should look like a network graph, not random scribbles
- Text must remain readable when figure is scaled to ~78% of textwidth (~5.1 inches wide)
- Minimum font size after scaling: 7pt
- Consistent vertical alignment of predictor bars across all three panels
